visuddhan.g: catutthajjhānaṁ upekkhañca samathañca laddhā labhitvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvāti laddhānupekkhaṁ samathaṁ visuddhaṁ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
rāgādirajānaṁ vigamā aṅgaṇānaṁ abhāvā malānañca vigamā vigatarajamanaṅgaṇaṁ visuddhaṁ.

visuddhan.l: Imaṁ niraggaḷaṁ yaññaṁ yajitvā tividhaṁ visuddhan
visuddhan.g: anāvaṭadvāratāya muttacāgatāya ca niraggaḷaṁ, tīsupi kālesu tīhi dvārehi karaṇakārāpanānussaraṇavidhīhi sampannatāya tividhaṁ, tattha saṁkilesābhāvena visuddhaṁ aparimitadhanapariccāgabhāvena mahācāgatāya yaññaṁ yajitvā, mahādānaṁ datvāti attho.

Visuddhasīlādīnaṁ.g: “visuddhasīlassa paṭhamajjhānaṁ, paṭhamajjhānalābhino dutiyajjhānan”ti-ādinā tassa tassa uparūpari visesaṁ ācikkhantoti sambandho.

Visuddhibhāvanānukkamavasenā.g: heṭṭhimavisuddhiyā ānubhāvena adhigatātisayāya paṭipadāññāṇadassanavisuddhibhāvanāya, sabbasaṅkhārehi nibbindanavirajjanādivisaṁyogādhimutti-appanāya ca paṭipakkhabhūtānaṁ pāpadhammānaṁ vigamoti evaṁbhūtassa visuddhibhāvanānukkamassa vasena lokuttarajjhānaṁ appanāppattameva hoti.
